name: PathVQA
intro: PathVQA 是由病理教材与 PEIR 数字图书馆半自动构建、并逐题人工校对的病理图像问答基准。版本边界必须保留：arXiv v1 为 4,998 张图像与 32,799 个问答，ACL 2021 论文为 32,795 个问答；固定社区镜像对作者 2023 更新去重后为 4,289 张被引用图像与 32,632 个问答。
org: University of California, San Diego; Beijing University of Technology; Carnegie Mellon University
build_method: 教材与PEIR图文抽取, CoreNLP与Tregex问答生成, 全量人工校验
metric: Accuracy, Exact Match, Macro F1, BLEU-1/2/3
eval_feature: 7类问题, 开放式与是非题平衡, 图像级划分, 多指标评测
scale: arXiv v1：4,998张图像、32,799个问答；ACL 2021：32,795个问答；固定镜像去重后：4,289张被引用图像、32,632个问答
build_method_en: Textbook and PEIR image-caption extraction, CoreNLP and Tregex QA generation, full manual verification
eval_feature_en: Seven question types, balanced open-ended and yes/no questions, image-level splits, multiple evaluation metrics
intro_en: PathVQA is a pathology VQA benchmark built semi-automatically from pathology textbooks and PEIR, followed by manual proofreading of every question. Its version boundary must remain explicit: arXiv v1 reports 4,998 images and 32,799 QA pairs, the ACL 2021 paper reports 32,795 QA pairs, and the pinned mirror deduplicates the authors' 2023 update to 32,632 QA pairs on 4,289 referenced images.

drawio_review_note: reviewed_at=2026-07-22; scope=source-stage paper-level Build Process reconstruction for PathVQA; primary-paper-pin=https://arxiv.org/abs/2003.10286v1 and https://arxiv.org/pdf/2003.10286v1; arxiv-v1-pdf-sha256=cbfe071a8d806d510e4fe02eb242cc7173c866027d29704ad42b44408dc463e3; conference-paper-pin=https://aclanthology.org/2021.acl-short.90/ and https://aclanthology.org/2021.acl-short.90.pdf; acl-paper-pdf-sha256=9760f1711cdb1cdd1abb0a8d55e809590560852f6ae01791c03915a95ce13bf8; official-data-portal=https://pathvqachallenge.grand-challenge.org/Data_Info/; portal-snapshot-sha256=cf184045f5af56cff17206d17091de08daa97119a428b844c1d3e2fcd57ba05d. The official portal identifies the historical UCSD-AI4H/PathVQA repository, the arXiv preprint, 4,998 pathology images, 32,799 question-answer pairs, an approximately half open and half yes/no composition, and an official train/validation/test split. The historical official repository is no longer reachable at review time. A surviving dataset card records the authors' February 15 2023 update as historical commit 117e7f4ef88a0e65b0e7f37b98a73d6237a3ceab. That commit is retained as provenance and is not silently replaced by a different repository. Because its Git objects cannot currently be fetched, the graph does not claim a verified current official Git checkout. A fixed community mirror is used only to audit the updated released rows: https://huggingface.co/datasets/flaviagiammarino/path-vqa/tree/1685832883334b5bb5beaf4e4b333fdeecaa4ad9; mirror revision=1685832883334b5bb5beaf4e4b333fdeecaa4ad9; README sha256=16eaf70c5aa4f0a03a92f8872d5c33d0707594c07837be69fabdf6f457bda055; scripts/processing.py sha256=d0bb086b5f87f883652bfe7dff378b72ea9a72aeedcab5b8d5553fdea59fb7c6. The mirror states that it was built from the authors' updated Google Drive archive, not from a separately authored replacement dataset. Its fixed LFS objects include test shards 533175be08e87b9ccf2fc06e2f82e58bb2e9bf2299a4a138cf5311f1d26ac157, 84bde926245c4b136de6ef48b197a0f3f177b3fbcb03b7f3cbfcfcb212f20c50, and ae676f41a7ddfc85be8503a731c719e1608da37ddc981de42a10dd2d55a8ee87; these identifiers pin the mirror payload without elevating it to an official source. Construction follows arXiv v1 sections 3 and 4. The motivation is specific: public pathology images are scarce because of privacy and domain restrictions, and trained pathologists have little time for large-scale annotation. The authors therefore use two public pathology textbooks, Textbook of Pathology and Basic Pathology, plus the Pathology Education Informational Resource digital library. For PDF textbooks, PyPDF2 reads page Resources and image XObjects, while PDFMiner extracts text with exact page locations. Regular expressions locate snippets prefixed by Fig. or Figure and figure numbers. When a page contains multiple items, images and captions are separately ordered by location and paired by order. For PEIR, Requests retrieves pages and image files, while Beautiful Soup locates images under the targeted HTML tags and captions are written beside local files. Post-processing removes non-pathology material such as flowcharts and portraits and corrects erroneous image-caption matching. Question generation is linguistic rather than crowdsourced free-form invention. Stanford CoreNLP performs sentence splitting, tokenization, part-of-speech tagging, named-entity recognition, constituency parsing, and dependency parsing. Long captions are simplified by rearranging subjects, verbs, and clauses with the cited syntactic rules. Tregex queries constituency trees and implements the question-transformation rules. The transducer decomposes main verbs where appropriate and applies subject-auxiliary inversion. Inversion produces yes/no questions whose unchanged propositions answer yes. To create no questions, a phrase with the same POS tag is randomly selected from another caption and substituted for the original head phrase. Open questions remove target answer phrases and insert question phrases for what, where, when, whose, how, and how much/how many. The diagram intentionally does not import the ACL paper's extra 'why' label into the arXiv-v1 construction count. All automatically generated questions then receive manual proofreading. The disclosed pass corrects spelling, syntax, and semantic inconsistencies; removes extra spaces and irrelevant symbols; removes questions that are too short or vague; and strips leading articles from answers. The graph does not infer an undisclosed annotator count, expert credential, inter-annotator agreement procedure, or hidden model-based filter. The arXiv-v1 scope is preserved verbatim: 1,670 images come from the two textbooks and 3,328 from PEIR, for 4,998 images and 32,799 QA pairs. The first six question categories contain 16,465 open-ended questions; yes/no contains 16,334, with 8,145 yes and 8,189 no answers. The paper's official image-level random split is 0.5/0.3/0.2: train has 2,499 images and 17,325 QA pairs, validation has 1,499 images and 9,462 QA pairs, and test has 1,000 images and 6,012 QA pairs. Evaluation is also kept version-specific. The arXiv-v1 paper runs disclosed VQA baselines on one image-question pair and compares generated answers with references. Binary yes/no questions use accuracy. Open-ended questions use exact match, macro-averaged F1 over bag-of-token overlap, and BLEU n-gram similarity, reported as BLEU-1, BLEU-2, and BLEU-3. The diagram does not reinterpret these metrics as an LLM judge. Three count regimes are intentionally not collapsed. Regime one is arXiv v1: 4,998 images and 32,799 QA pairs with the 2,499/1,499/1,000 image split. Regime two is the ACL 2021 paper: 4,998 images and 32,795 QA pairs, with appendix split counts 19,755 train, 6,279 validation, and 6,761 test. Regime three is the authors' 2023 updated archive as documented by the pinned mirror: 5,004 image files and 32,795 QA triples before deduplication, of which 4,289 images are referenced and 715 are unused; after exact triplet deduplication the mirror exposes 19,654 train, 6,259 validation, and 6,719 test rows, totaling 32,632. These are release-version facts, not evidence that one paper's count should overwrite another. Reproducibility boundaries are explicit. No official inference prompt, answer parser, LLM judge, generation configuration, decoding parameters, or immutable trained checkpoint is disclosed by the two papers, official portal, or pinned mirror; none is invented. The papers describe trained VQA systems and their evaluation settings, not a modern prompted-LLM protocol. Openness is also bounded. The historical repository and mirror state MIT for the dataset package, while the source images and captions remain copyrighted by the two textbook publishers and authors and by PEIR owners. The diagram therefore records package licensing separately from source-content rights. Solid edges encode only paper-disclosed construction and evaluation order. Dashed edges encode fixed evidence, the arXiv-to-ACL count drift, the later author-update/community-mirror boundary, the unavailable prompt/parser/judge boundary, and source copyright. Formal drawio, arch, SVG, PNG generation, fallback synchronization, manifest registration, and site publication are deliberately outside this source-stage handoff. Formal publication evidence [site-a12d-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 4365×825 (English) and 4365×825 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 4363×823 and 4363×823. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
